name: web-black-orange-analytics-dashboard-on-monitor-with-glow
title: Black and Orange Analytics Dashboard on Monitor
whatItIs: A dark monitor showing a black analytics dashboard with orange highlight cards, stacked bar charts, donut charts and product lists, against a black background with an orange glow at the base.
whatItMeans: Orange on black feels energetic and technical, and the varied chart types keep a dense screen scannable.
techniques: Orange accent cards among dark tiles
Mixed chart types (bars, donuts, dotted bars)

vocabulary.definition: A dashboard tile of one size holding one visual.
A card filled with the accent colour to lead the eye.
A coloured light rising from the bottom edge.
